functions.notes: Only real difference: ours hoists the loop-invariant pool constant 0x802 (used for 0x805, 0x802, 0xc02 tile ids) above the elems loop and spills it to [sp+0x14]; target reloads the pool word at each use (ldr r1,[pc]; add #3 / add #0x400) with nothing hoisted. This costs one stack slot (push r3, sub sp #0x18) plus 8 bytes. Tried: tile/mode param types (unsigned short, short, unsigned), 0x802+3 and 0x802|0x400 forms, unsigned short casts, declaration order of locals (3 permutations), moving the c&=0x3ff mask into the uses, masked copy as a new local, colorsweep --apply, aligned attribute on struct members (hack, only grows). None reduced the diff; ~22 gate runs.
